events.title: QuEra joins three ARPA-E QC3 quantum chemistry teams
events.summary: QuEra said its scientists will work with three of the nine teams selected for ARPA-E's Quantum Computing for Computational Chemistry (QC3) program.
events.source_title: QuEra Scientists Named Co-Principal Investigators on Three of Nine Teams in Department of Energy's Quantum Chemistry Program, Now Underway
events.excerpt: today announced that its scientists will work with three of the nine teams selected for the Quantum Computing for Computational Chemistry (QC3) program at the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Energy (ARPA-E)

events.title: D-Wave Advantage2 system arrives in Como, Italy for installation
events.summary: D-Wave said its Advantage2 annealing quantum computer, funded by Swiss Quantum Technology SA, arrived in Lombardy for installation at Villa Saporiti in Como.
events.source_title: D-Wave Delivers Italy's First Annealing Quantum Computer
events.excerpt: today announced at Digital Innovation Forum 2026 that its Advantage2™ annealing quantum computer has arrived in Lombardy, Italy, for installation at Villa Saporiti in Como.

events.title: SkyWater and D-Wave sign multi-year quantum manufacturing agreement
events.summary: SkyWater Technology and D-Wave announced a multi-year agreement extending their partnership on semiconductor process development and manufacturing for D-Wave's roadmap.
events.source_title: SkyWater and D-Wave Extend Quantum Manufacturing Collaboration Through Multi-Year Agreement
events.excerpt: This collaboration extends the long-established partnership between both companies, to continue specialized semiconductor process development and manufacturing in support of D-Wave's quantum technology roadmap.

events.title: IonQ to acquire Elisity in all-stock deal valued up to $1.3B
events.summary: IonQ agreed to acquire Zero Trust security company Elisity in an all-stock transaction valued at up to $1.3 billion.
events.source_title: IonQ to Acquire Elisity to Accelerate Zero Trust for the Quantum Era
events.excerpt: today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Elisity, Inc., a Zero Trust security company, in an all-stock transaction valued at up to $1.3 billion.

events.title: IonQ reports 1 kHz ion-to-quantum-memory photonic interconnect
events.summary: IonQ reported a photonic interconnect generating more than 1,000 entangled connections per second between a trapped-ion qubit and a silicon vacancy quantum memory.
events.source_title: IonQ Demonstrates World-First Quantum Memory-Enhanced Interconnect for Distributed Quantum Applications
events.excerpt: Photonic interconnect generates more than 1,000 quantum connections per second between a trapped ion qubit and a silicon vacancy quantum memory.

events.title: PsiQuantum gets conditional $150M loan commitment from DoW OSC
events.summary: PsiQuantum received a conditional commitment for a loan of up to $150 million from the Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital to expand U.S. manufacturing and prototyping.
events.source_title: PsiQuantum Receives Conditional $150 Million Loan Commitment from the U.S. Department of War to Advance Domestic Quantum Computing
events.excerpt: PsiQuantum announced today that the company has received a conditional commitment for a loan of up to $150 million from the U.S. Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital (OSC)

events.title: IonQ advances to DARPA QBI Stage C under agreement worth up to $300M
events.summary: IonQ said it will advance to Stage C of DARPA's QBI under an agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million.
events.source_title: IonQ Advances to Final Stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
events.excerpt: Under an agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million, IonQ will advance to Stage C of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative.

events.title: IBM selected for Stage C of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
events.summary: IBM announced its selection for Stage C, the third phase of DARPA's QBI, for independent verification of its fault-tolerance approach.
events.source_title: IBM Advances to Stage C of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
events.excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has been selected for Stage C, the third phase of the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) led by DARPA

events.title: Atom Computing advances to final stage of DARPA QBI
events.summary: DARPA selected Atom Computing for the final stage of the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, a stage with potential funding of up to $300 million.
events.source_title: Atom Computing Selected by DARPA for Final Stage of Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
events.excerpt: This stage, with potential funding of up to $300 million, reinforces the momentum behind Atom Computing's vision and roadmap for building a utility-scale quantum computer using neutral-atom quantum technology.

events.title: QCi announces Dirac-3S optimization system scaling to ~10,000 variables
events.summary: QCi announced Dirac-3S, scaling quantum optimization to nearly 10,000 variables, with first customer shipment of the upgrade expected in Q4 2026.
events.source_title: Quantum Computing Inc. Announces Dirac-3S, Scaling to Nearly 10,000 Variables
events.excerpt: Scales quantum optimization to up to nearly 10,000 variables, a 10x increase over QCi's current 1,000-variable system, while delivering faster performance, production-ready reliability and scalable manufacturing. First customer shipment of Dirac-3S upgrade expected in Q4 2026.

events.title: Pasqal appoints Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer
events.summary: Pasqal named Florence Lao Chief Legal Officer, advising its executive team and board as a publicly traded company.
events.source_title: Pasqal Appoints Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer
events.excerpt: Pasqal (NASDAQ: PSQL), a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, today announced the appointment of Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer.

events.title: D-Wave launches gate-model simulator beta program
events.summary: D-Wave launched a beta program giving select customers early access to its gate-model quantum computing simulator ahead of general availability.
events.source_title: D-Wave Launches Gate-Model Simulator Beta Program, Advancing Error-Aware Programming Capabilities
events.excerpt: today launched its gate-model quantum computing simulator beta program, marking an important milestone in D-Wave's gate-model development roadmap.

events.title: Pasqal exits French defense program LSQUARE (PROQCIMA)
events.summary: Pasqal said it is refocusing its collaboration with French public authorities on commercial applications, including ending its participation in the LSQUARE (PROQCIMA) defense program.
events.source_title: Pasqal Announces an Evolution of Its Collaboration Framework with the French Public Authorities
events.excerpt: This evolution includes the termination of Pasqal's participation in the defense program LSQUARE (otherwise known as PROQCIMA), to which Pasqal participated in its first phase and successfully completed all the technological objectives.

events.title: IonQ to deliver Superion 256-qubit system to Florida International University
events.summary: IonQ announced a contract to deliver its Superion 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer for installation at FIU.
events.source_title: IonQ | FIU Secures Florida's First IonQ Superion Quantum System
events.excerpt: Under the agreement, IonQ will deliver its Superion 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer for installation at FIU.

events.title: IonQ demonstrates real-time QEC decoder on a single standard CPU
events.summary: IonQ announced an end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder running on a single off-the-shelf CPU.
events.source_title: IonQ Demonstrates Industry's First End-to-End Real-Time Quantum Error Decoder
events.excerpt: Researchers demonstrated the development and successful testing of the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder that runs on a single standard off-the-shelf central processing unit (CPU).

events.title: QuEra collaborates with HPE on on-premises fault-tolerant quantum-HPC
events.summary: QuEra announced a collaboration with HPE to integrate neutral-atom fault-tolerant quantum computing with HPE Cray-powered HPC environments.
events.source_title: QuEra Computing Collaborates with HPE to Bring Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing to On-Premises HPC Environments
events.excerpt: QuEra Computing, the leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, today announced a collaboration with HPE to integrate neutral-atom, fault-tolerant quantum computing with on-premise high-performance computing (HPC) environments powered by the HPE Cray supercomputing platform.

events.title: Pasqal marks Nasdaq public listing under ticker PSQL
events.summary: Pasqal announced it would ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell to mark its recent public listing under the ticker PSQL; the release does not state the listing mechanism or capital raised.
events.source_title: Pasqal to Ring Nasdaq Closing Bell on September 17
events.excerpt: today announced that it will ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell on September 17, 2026, marking the Company's recent public listing under the ticker symbol NASDAQ: PSQL.

events.title: IBM's Anderon finalizes $1B CHIPS award for US quantum foundry
events.summary: Anderon, an IBM company, finalized a $1 billion CHIPS and Science Act award with the US Department of Commerce for quantum wafer manufacturing R&D.
events.source_title: Anderon, an IBM Company, Finalizes Agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce for a $1 Billion CHIPS Award to Accelerate R&D for U.S.-Based Pure-Play Quantum Foundry
events.excerpt: The award will accelerate Anderon's R&D efforts to advance the nation's quantum wafer manufacturing capabilities.

events.title: QCi signs three-year framework agreement with Hamad Bin Khalifa University
events.summary: QCi signed a three-year framework agreement with HBKU in Qatar to collaborate on quantum computing, sensing and communications.
events.source_title: Quantum Computing Inc. Expands Global Quantum Adoption Through New Hamad Bin Khalifa University Framework Agreement
events.excerpt: today announced it has signed a three-year Framework Agreement with Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Qatar (HBKU) to collaborate in quantum computing, quantum sensing, and quantum communications.

events.title: Quantinuum finalizes $100M CHIPS R&D award with US Commerce
events.summary: Quantinuum finalized a $100 million CHIPS R&D award to advance US trapped-ion quantum computer manufacturing, partnering with GlobalFoundries and Monarch Quantum.
events.source_title: Quantinuum Finalizes $100 Million CHIPS R&D Award with U.S. Department of Commerce to Advance Trapped-Ion Quantum Computer Manufacturing in the US
events.excerpt: The federal funding supports critical R&D and U.S. quantum semiconductor manufacturing capabilities needed to scale fault-tolerant trapped-ion quantum computing.

events.title: D-Wave finalizes up to $100M CHIPS Act agreement with U.S. Commerce
events.summary: D-Wave executed a definitive agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce, following an earlier letter of intent, giving it access to up to $100 million in CHIPS Act funding.
events.source_title: D-Wave Quantum Finalizes Definitive Agreement with U.S. Department of Commerce for Up to $100 Million to Accelerate U.S. Leadership in Quantum Computing
events.excerpt: D-Wave now has access to up to $100 million of U.S. CHIPS and Science Act funding.

events.title: Quantinuum signs non-binding MOU with Aramco
events.summary: Quantinuum and Aramco signed a non-binding MOU to explore industrial quantum use cases and a potential fault-tolerant research collaboration.
events.source_title: Quantinuum Signs Non-binding MOU with Aramco to Explore Synergies Leveraging Industrial Quantum Computing Research, Applications, and Expertise
events.excerpt: Under the MOU, the companies intend to undertake preliminary technical onboarding and engage in knowledge exchange activities.

events.title: Atom Computing appoints Kevin Messerle as CFO
events.summary: Atom Computing named Kevin Messerle Chief Financial Officer as it scales operations.
events.source_title: Atom Computing Appoints Kevin Messerle as Chief Financial Officer
events.excerpt: Atom Computing, a leader in the race to build practical quantum computers, today announced the appointment of Kevin Messerle as Chief Financial Officer.

events.title: IBM joins and cools two cryogenic modules into one environment
events.summary: IBM announced it connected and cooled two cryogenic modules into a single environment, a step toward linking many quantum chips.
events.source_title: IBM Connects Its First Modular Cryogenic Systems in Milestone Toward Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
events.excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has successfully joined and cooled down two cryogenic modules into a single environment.

events.title: Quantinuum partners with Quanta Computer on quantum manufacturing foundation
events.summary: Quantinuum and Quanta Computer plan to co-develop infrastructure, systems engineering and manufacturing capabilities for future quantum computers.
events.source_title: Quanta Computer and Quantinuum Partner to Build an Industrial Foundation for Large-Scale Quantum Computing
events.excerpt: Companies plan to co-develop the infrastructure, systems engineering, and manufacturing capabilities required for future generations of quantum computers.

events.title: D-Wave reports high-fidelity two-qubit gate for dual-rail qubits in Nature
events.summary: D-Wave announced research published in Nature demonstrating a fast, high-fidelity two-qubit entangling gate on its superconducting dual-rail qubit architecture.
events.source_title: D-Wave Demonstrates Major Hardware Breakthrough for Quantum Error Correction, Advancing the Path to Practical, Fault-Tolerant Gate-Model Quantum Computing
events.excerpt: Published in the peer-reviewed scientific journal Nature, the research demonstrates a fast, high-fidelity, two-qubit entangling gate that preserves the error-correction advantages of D-Wave's superconducting dual-rail qubit architecture.

events.title: IBM and Algorithmiq claim quantum advantage in materials simulation
events.summary: IBM and Algorithmiq announced a joint quantum advantage demonstration simulating a heterogeneous quantum material, with a framework for trusting results without classical verification.
events.source_title: IBM and Algorithmiq Demonstrate Quantum Advantage, Establishing a Framework for Trusted Quantum Computation Beyond Classical Verification
events.excerpt: Today, Algorithmiq and IBM (NYSE: IBM) announced a major milestone in the development of quantum computing: a joint demonstration of quantum advantage with the simulation of a heterogeneous quantum material

events.title: IBM agrees to acquire HRL Laboratories
events.summary: IBM signed a definitive agreement to acquire HRL Laboratories, the research institution jointly owned by Boeing and General Motors; deal value was not disclosed.
events.source_title: IBM to Acquire HRL Laboratories to Power the Future of Quantum
events.excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire HRL Laboratories, LLC (HRL), a flagship research and development institution.

events.title: PsiQuantum signs $125M expanded agreement with DARPA under QBI
events.summary: PsiQuantum signed a $125 million expanded agreement with DARPA under the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative and remains one of two companies in Stage C.
events.source_title: PsiQuantum Signs $125 Million Agreement with DARPA
events.excerpt: PsiQuantum today announced that the company has signed a new $125 million expanded agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) under DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI)

events.title: PsiQuantum breaks ground on utility-scale quantum computer site in Australia
events.summary: PsiQuantum began construction at Moreton Bay Central, Queensland, where it plans to build and deploy a utility-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer.
events.source_title: PsiQuantum Breaks Ground in Australia on Site of World's First Utility-Scale Quantum Computer
events.excerpt: PsiQuantum today broke ground and started construction on its facility at Moreton Bay Central, where the company will build and deploy the world's first utility-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer.

events.title: Atom Computing raises over $300M including $100M Series C
events.summary: Atom Computing said it has raised more than $300 million to date, including a $100 million Series C led by Third Point Ventures and a planned $100 million from the U.S. Department of Commerce.
events.source_title: Atom Computing Raises More Than $300 Million to Accelerate Deployment of Fault-Tolerant, Neutral-Atom Quantum Computers
events.excerpt: Atom Computing has raised over $300 million to date, including a $100 million Series C round led by Third Point Ventures and a planned $100 million from the U.S. Department of Commerce

events.title: Alice & Bob unveils Helium, its first full quantum system
events.summary: Alice & Bob unveiled the Helium Quantum System for on-premise deployment, engineered to encode its first logical qubit with as few as 18 cat qubits.
events.source_title: Alice & Bob Unveils First Quantum System Available for Research Partners
events.excerpt: today unveiled the Helium Quantum System, marking the expansion from developing cat-qubit chips to delivering a complete quantum computing system for on-premise deployment.

events.title: Microsoft unveils Majorana 2 topological quantum processor
events.summary: Microsoft announced Majorana 2, stating its qubits are 1,000x more reliable than those in its previous quantum processing unit. Date taken from the Microsoft Quantum blog listing.
events.source_title: Microsoft Azure Quantum Blog
events.excerpt: Majorana 2 contains qubits that are 1,000x more reliable than those in our previous quantum processing unit.

events.title: IBM commits more than $10 billion to quantum computing over five years
events.summary: IBM announced plans to invest more than $10 billion in quantum computing over five years across R&D, capex, manufacturing, partnerships and M&A.
events.source_title: IBM Commits More Than $10 Billion to Quantum Computing, Funding Its Roadmap from Today's Leading Systems to the World's First Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers
events.excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) has announced plans to invest more than $10 billion in quantum computing over the next five years.

claims.source_title: How IBM will build the world's first large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer

claims.status_note: Q2 2026 results, Aug 11, 2026: 'Apollo remains on schedule for 2029, with significant progress made across key architectural subsystems through prototyping.'
